text:
maria (Marketing Ops): Quick sync — proposing a canary for 'priority fallthrough' SLA on inbound leads. TL;DR: if HubSpot owner is empty for >30s, route to geo-priority RR pool (EMEA/NA fallback) for 2m before backfill to overflow. We'll measure claim_time, first_contact_rate, conversion. Need SalesOps + SDR buy-in before rolling.

ajay (Growth): Sounds reasonable. What volume are we expecting for the canary? Can we limit to 2% of total leads by origin=web and source=paid?

maria (Marketing Ops): Canary = 2% web-paid > EMEA/NA, +only leads with enrichment_status=complete. Will tag with metadata: priority_fallthrough=canary-1. Metrics: claim_time (s), claimed_by (SDR id), lead_age when claimed.

sasha (SalesOps): Heads-up — SF mapping currently links HS owner field -> SF Owner via webhook. If we re-route before mapping runs, we might create dup owners. Two asks: 1) throttle the handoff webhook for canary leads, 2) add a temporary dedupe stage in the RR logic.

tom (RevOps): Re enrichment TTL — our hs-enrich job runs every ~45s. If you're routing at 30s, many leads won't have email/phone. Recommend enrichment_status=complete filter as maria said. Also suggest extending claim window to 3m for this canary so SDRs get more time.

eva (SDR): 2m feels tight on busy days. Also need notification cadence: no more than 1 page per lead and add Slack pings only for priority leads. Otherwise we'll get alert fatigue. :raised_hands:

maria (Marketing Ops): Good call. Change proposal: keep 2% sample, require enrichment_status=complete, window=3m, notify Slack #sdr-priority, paged only if lead_score>80. We'll capture reaction and opt-out flags.

leadflow-bot: Sample RR rule (yaml):
```
routing_rule:
  name: priority_fallthrough_canary
  sample_pct: 2
  filters:
    - origin: web
    - source: paid
    - enrichment_status: complete
  route:
    - geo_priority_pool: [EMEA, NA]
    - fallback_queue: overflow_priority
  window_seconds: 180
  notify_channel: "#sdr-priority"
```

ajay (Growth): Also add metric for 'routing-misses' where backfill was used. We'll A/B compare conversion vs control group.

sasha (SalesOps): I'll add the webhook throttle and dedupe layer. Tom, can you add an observability tag so we can track webhook latency per lead?

tom (RevOps): Yep — will add trace headers and a 'canary_id' tag. I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow at 10am to validate dashboards and alert thresholds.

eva (SDR): Thanks — can I get a quick doc on the new notification rules? Even a 1-pager to paste in our ops channel.

maria (Marketing Ops): I'll write a 1-pager and drop in #marketing-ops by EOD. Action items: maria write doc, sasha add dedupe + throttle, tom add observability, ajay add routing-miss metric. Rollout target: next Wed (canary open for 48h). :rocket:

sasha (SalesOps): Added to my queue. Will post PR link when done.

leadflow-bot: Canary rule created in staging (id: cf-202503). Monitor metrics at https://dash.redwood.ai/leads/canary/cf-202503

maria (Marketing Ops): Thanks everyone. If no objections by EOD, we'll flip the flag in staging and run the 2% canary next Wed.
